observed_problem: Action Specs bound Production State/Profile but did not expose the exact transitive stage-input authorities consumed by later deterministic actions.
expected_behavior: Each action is planned from State/Profile plus exact State-pinned checkpoint/gate authorities, and upstream artifact drift invalidates planning before execution.
actual_behavior: Stage-local validators could preserve correctness while orchestration provenance alone could not reconstruct the exact upstream artifact basis.
improvement_action: Include exact State-pinned checkpoint/gate authority refs in Action Spec required_inputs and revalidate attestation-contained artifact refs before replanning.
